urmzd-agentspec-crates-agentspec-agentsp.description: How and when to use the agentspec CLI to manage skills, agents, MCP servers, sessions, memories, and project config across AI coding tools. Use when asked to install or share a skill, register an MCP server everywhere, find a past AI session, or sync agent resources between Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Gemini, Cursor, and friends.

urmzd-agentspec-crates-agentspec-resourc.description: Reference for the file formats, locations, and discovery conventions agentspec manages across AI coding tools (skills, agents, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, llms.txt, instruction files, plans, memories, sessions, MCP, permissions, hooks, plugins). Use when you need to know where a resource lives, what format it uses, how agentspec discovers it, or how it maps into the ~/.agents canonical store.
